parsed.change_summary: Added a try-catch block around the regex object creation to handle invalid regex patterns and prevent OS command injection.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger is blocked by catching the `std::regex_error` exception that is thrown when an invalid regex pattern is provided. This prevents the malicious regex pattern from being used to inject shell commands.
parsed.behavior_changes: If an invalid regex pattern is provided, the function will now print an error message and return without processing the file, instead of potentially executing a malicious command.
